Name: SYNO Mabar
Author: SYNOSTORE
Description: Win / Lose dan On / Off untuk overlay SYNO. Win/Lose: tekan = tambah, tahan = tolak 1, tahan 2 saat = reset. On/Off: facecam, handcam atau Mabar OPEN / CLOSED.

Actions.Name: Win (tekan / tahan)
Actions.Tooltip: Tekan: Menang. Tahan 0.6 s: Win -1. Tahan 2 s: Win jadi 0.

Actions.Name: Lose (tekan / tahan)
Actions.Tooltip: Tekan: Kalah. Tahan 0.6 s: Lose -1. Tahan 2 s: Lose jadi 0.

Actions.Name: On / Off (kamera, Mabar)
Actions.Tooltip: Tekan: on / off facecam, handcam atau Mabar OPEN / CLOSED. Butang tunjuk ON / OFF sekarang.
